title: Map vs. Filter
instructions: What is the difference between `.map` and `.filter`?

options.text: .map keeps elements matching a condition, .filter transforms each element
.map transforms each element, .filter keeps elements matching a condition

explanation: `.map` transforms each element in the list by applying a lambda to it (for example, doubling every number). `.filter` keeps only the elements where the lambda returns true (for example, keeping numbers above 50). They do different jobs and are often chained together.
